vision.tag: A MORE NATURAL WAY TO EXPERIENCE TOURISM
vision.description: Behind every tour there are people, places, and moments worth enjoying. TourMate was created to bring them closer with simplicity: a friendly experience for agencies, guides, and travelers.
vision.clarity-desc: The right amount of information to understand and enjoy each experience.
vision.trust-desc: Close support before, during, and after the trip.
vision.memories-desc: Because what matters isn't just arriving, but everything that stays with you.

app-preview.description: Explore the tourist and agency interfaces: real time map, vital sign monitoring, offline navigation and the live dashboard all in one ecosystem.

problem.description: The agencies manage remote groups using radios and phone calls. The trekkers get lost, suffer altitude sickness, or experience medical emergencies with no way to alert others in time. There's no tracking, no history, and no digital experience to build tourist loyalty.
problem.stat-tourists-desc: Foreign tourists visit Peru annually, many for extreme adventure.
problem.stat-iot-desc: Local agencies use platforms with integrated IoT monitoring
problem.stat-days-desc: Average number of days for a trek without visibility for the agency
problem.stat-liability-desc: Legal liability for incidents without an active monitoring system

narrative.description: The same story, every trek: a group sets off, something happens on the trail, and the right people find out in time to help.
narrative.step1-desc: Your tourists set off on the trail wearing their vitals monitor and offline map, connected to you from minute one.
narrative.step2-desc: A heart rate spike, an unexpected stop, a lost signal. TourMate notices before it becomes an emergency.
narrative.step3-desc: Your team gets the exact location and context to respond, and your tourist gets home safe.

tourists.description: TourMate transforms your smartphone into a personal navigation, tracking, and security system. Explore with confidence knowing that someone always knows your location, even without internet access.
tourists.offline-nav-desc: Download maps and routes before you leave. Works in areas without signal using native GPS.
tourists.wearable-desc: Pulse, oxygenation, and temperature travel with you, always in sync with the people looking out for you.
tourists.experience-desc: Photos, notes, and achievements from the tour are automatically saved with geographical context.
tourists.contextual-info-desc: History, wildlife, altitude, climate and points of interest as you progress along the route.
tourists.feat-maps-desc: Downloadable maps with checkpoints, danger zones, and points of interest. Works offline.
tourists.feat-health-desc: If something feels off, your guide knows before you do. Heart rate and oxygen watched over, every step of the way.
tourists.feat-gps-desc: Someone always knows exactly where you are: your guide and emergency contacts, in real time.
tourists.feat-memory-desc: Geotagged photos and videos shared with other travelers at the same route points.

ecosystem.title: TourMate IoT Ecosystem
ecosystem.description: An integrated ecosystem of hardware and software that captures, synchronizes, and displays data from each adventure in real time or offline.
ecosystem.wearables-desc: Compact devices that capture pulse, SpO₂, body temperature and GPS location with long battery life.
ecosystem.bluetooth-desc: Beacons installed on key routes that record the passage of each tourist and relay data even without WiFi.
ecosystem.mobile-desc: Offline navigation, experience recording, and contextual tour information for tourists.
ecosystem.web-desc: Dashboard for agencies with live maps, automatic alerts and detailed reports for each tour.

novedades.title: What's new at TourMate
novedades.subtitle: Small improvements, shipped often. Here's what changed recently.
novedades.item1-desc: Wearable data now syncs up to 3x faster the moment a signal is found.
novedades.item2-desc: Every completed tour now gets a shareable journal with photos, route and vitals.
novedades.item3-desc: Agencies on the Pro plan can now install up to 10 trailside checkpoints.

testimonials.title: What our users say
testimonials.subtitle: Agencies and adventurers who are already familiar with TourMate share their perspective.
testimonials.quote-mendoza: As an agency, the hardest part was always knowing our groups were safe when there was no signal. With TourMate, that fear disappears. The Bluetooth checkpoints are fantastic.
testimonials.quote-reyes: I did the 4-day Choquequirao trek and the automatic journal it generated at the end was incredible. Photos, routes, my vital signs at each point. I wouldn't have documented it the same way on my own.
testimonials.story-context: Solo trekker, no support crew, four days on the Choquequirao trail.
testimonials.quote-quispe: Our foreign clients often ask us about security in remote areas. Showing them the real-time monitoring panel closes sales that we previously lost due to that fear.

about.title: We are a team passionate about safe adventure.
about.description: TourMate was born out of frustration at seeing adventure tourism grow without the technological tools it deserves. We are five Peruvian engineers who believe that exploring the world should be a free, connected, and safe experience for everyone.
about.card-identity-desc: TourMate is a platform that integrates wearable hardware, smart checkpoints, and cloud-based software to transform the management of adventure tours in Peru and Latin America.
about.card-mission-desc: Our mission is to provide tourists and agencies with the necessary technological tools to enjoy adventure experiences with real-time information, preventing risks and preserving the excitement of the unknown.
about.card-vision-title: The global standard for smart tourism
about.card-vision-desc: By 2028, to be the leading platform in Latin America for adventure tour management, expanding our IoT network to the continent's main trekking routes.

faq.title: Questions? We're happy to answer them.
faq.q1: What happens to my tourists' data?
faq.a1_html: It's encrypted and used only to keep your tours safe, we never sell it. Full details in our Privacy Policy.
faq.q2: Do you help us implement it?
faq.a2: Yes. Every agency plan includes onboarding, guide training, and initial hardware setup.
faq.q3: Does it work without internet signal?
faq.a3: Yes. TourMate is built for the backcountry: it stores data locally and syncs automatically the moment a signal is available.
faq.q4: What if a tourist has a real medical emergency?
faq.a4: TourMate is a monitoring and alert tool, not a replacement for emergency services, but it gives your guide the information they need to respond fast.
faq.q5: Can I try it before paying?
faq.a5: Yes. The Trekker and Pro plans include a 7-day free trial, no strings attached.

s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
s1.p1: Welcome to TourMate. By using our services, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. This agreement is a legal contract between you and TourMate ("we", "us", "our").

s2.title: 2. Description of Service
s2.p1: TourMate provides an IoT platform for monitoring individuals during adventure tourism activities. Our service is a supplementary tool for safety and is not a substitute for professional medical advice or emergency services.

s3.title: 3. Ethical Commitment
s3.p1: We adhere to the principles of the ACM/IEEE Code of Ethics for Software Engineering and the CIP Code of Ethics, prioritizing public interest, client and employer, and product quality.

s4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
s4.li1: You are responsible for the responsible use of the platform.
s4.li2: You acknowledge that outdoor activities carry inherent risks.

s5.title: 5. Data Privacy
s5.p1_html: We are committed to protecting your privacy. Our data collection and use practices are detailed in our Privacy Policy.

s6.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
s6.p1: TourMate is a tool to assist in safety, not a guarantee of it. We are not liable for any incidents that may occur during your activities.

s7.title: 7. Changes to Terms
s7.p1: We may update these terms from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new terms on this page.

s1.title: 1. Introduction
s1.p1: TourMate is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and share your personal information.

s2.title: 2. Information We Collect
s2.p1: We may collect the following types of information:
s2.li1: Personal identification information (Name, email address, phone number, etc.)
s2.li3: Vital signs data (heart rate, SpO2) from wearable devices.
s2.li4: Technical data (IP address, browser type, etc.).

s3.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
s3.li2: Ensure the safety of users during tours.

s4.title: 4. Data Security
s4.p1: We implement robust security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure. We are committed to the principle of confidentiality and professional responsibility in handling all user data.

s5.title: 5. Your Rights
s5.p1: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. Please contact us to make a request.

s6.title: 6. Contact Us
s6.p1_html: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at TourMateperu@gmail.com.
